statutory_provisions: IPC s.302 r/w. s.34; Arms Act s.25/27
mitigating_circumstances: Good conduct, poor economic background, possibility of reformation
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of murder, acquitted of Arms Act charges
high_court_outcome: Confirmed conviction under IPC s.302, dismissed appeal
neutral_facts: The prosecution case is that on 30.10.1997 at 9.45 p.m., four individuals, including the accused, arrived at the victim's house and demanded jaggery. The victim refused, and the accused, under exhortation from others, shot the victim. The accused fled the scene, and the victim was taken to the hospital where he was declared dead. The police recovered a country-made pistol and an empty cartridge from the scene. Medical evidence confirmed the victim died from gunshot wounds. The accused were tried for murder and possession of arms. The trial court convicted the accused of murder but acquitted them of arms charges. The High Court affirmed the conviction for murder.
